description: This file defines a PHP class called pPie that provides functionality for drawing pie charts, including 2D, 3D, ring, and 3D ring charts, along with associated legend and label management. It handles data processing, chart rendering, and visual customization options.

classes.name: pPie
classes.description: Class to draw pie charts with functionalities to create 2D, 3D, ring, and labeled pie charts, including legend and label positioning.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor to initialize the pPie object with chart and data objects.

methods.name: draw2DPie
methods.description: Draws a 2D pie chart with customizable format options.

methods.name: draw3DPie
methods.description: Draws a 3D pie chart with customizable format options.

methods.name: drawPieLegend
methods.description: Draws the legend box associated with the pie chart.

methods.name: setSliceColor
methods.description: Sets the color of a specific pie slice.

methods.name: writePieLabel
methods.description: Calculates position and draws a label for a pie slice.

methods.name: shift
methods.description: Adjusts label positions to avoid overlap.

methods.name: writeShiftedLabels
methods.description: Draws labels at shifted positions after overlap resolution.

methods.name: arraySerialize
methods.description: Converts an array of numeric values into a comma-separated string.

methods.name: arrayReverse
methods.description: Reverses an array of plot points or values.

methods.name: clean0Values
methods.description: Removes unused series and null values from data and palette arrays.
